words.enExample: Morning coffee is my daily ritual.
words.zhExample: 晨间咖啡是我的日常仪式。
words.note: 不一定宗教，可指「固定会做的小事」。搭配 a bedtime ritual（睡前仪式）。近义 routine（常规）；区别：ritual 带点仪式感/心意，routine 偏机械重复。

words.enExample: I need a quiet weekend to recharge.
words.zhExample: 我需要一个安静的周末来充电。
words.note: re-（重新）+ charge（充电）。比喻用法极常见：recharge your batteries。近义 refresh（恢复精神）；反义 drain（耗尽）。职场金句：Take time to recharge.

words.enExample: We took a spontaneous trip to the coast.
words.zhExample: 我们一时兴起去了趟海边。
words.note: 来自 spont（自愿，同 response 的 spon-）。形容「没计划、凭当下兴致」。高频搭配：a spontaneous decision / invitation。近义 impromptu（即兴的）；反义 planned（计划好的）。

words.enExample: The system felt sluggish after the update.
words.zhExample: 更新后系统变得卡顿迟缓。
words.note: 本义像蛞蝓（slug）一样慢。形容人、机器、市场都可用：a sluggish market（低迷的市场）。近义 slow；反义 brisk（轻快利落的）。

words.enExample: My thoughts drifted to the sea.
words.note: 本义水流/风把东西带走；引申「走神、虚度」：drift through life（浑浑噩噩过日子）。近义 wander（游荡）；反义 focus（专注）。搭配 drift apart（关系疏远）。

essay.title: Sunday, Rewritten
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: For years my Sundays arrived with a list already written: the laundry, the replies, the errands I had postponed all week. I treated the one free day as a smaller weekday, to be spent clearing the leftovers of the one before.

Then a slow illness taught me that a day of rest is not a reward for work finished, but the thing that makes the work possible. So I began to rewrite Sundays, one small ritual at a time, starting with the right to do nothing useful before noon.

Now I let the morning drift. I read a page, forget it, read it again. I make coffee and watch the steam behave like weather. The tasks wait, and to my surprise they do not complain; the world runs fine without my constant tending.

By evening I am not more productive, only more human. The rewritten Sunday does not fix the week, but it reminds me I am a person before I am a worker — and that, it turns out, was the part I kept losing.
translations: 多年来，我的星期天总带着一张早已写好的清单上门：洗衣、回消息、还有一周里被我推迟的杂事。我把这唯一空闲的一天当成缩水的工作日，用来清理前一周的残局。
后来一场慢性的病教会我：休息日不是干完活后的奖赏，而是让活儿得以继续的东西。于是我开始改写星期天，一次一个小习惯，从「中午前有权什么都不做正事」开始。
如今我让早晨慢慢淌。读一页，忘掉，再读一遍。煮了咖啡，看热气像天气一样变幻。那些事等着，而令我意外的是它们并不抱怨——世界没有我时时照看，也照常运转。
到了晚上，我并没有更高效，只是更像个人了。被改写的星期天修不好这一周，却提醒我：在做工人之前，我先是个人——而这点，到头来正是我一直在弄丢的东西。

grammar.example: "a day of rest is not a reward for work finished, but the thing that makes the work possible"
grammar.note: that 修饰 the thing，引导定语从句说明「让工作得以继续的东西」；从句谓语 makes 用单数。 举一反三：举一反三：Sleep is the thing that repairs us.

grammar.example: "not a reward for work finished, but the thing that makes the work possible"
grammar.note: not A but B 否定前者、肯定后者，强调休息日的本质不是奖赏而是前提。 举一反三：举一反三：He is not a boss but a friend.

grammar.example: "and that, it turns out, was the part I kept losing"
grammar.note: it turns out 作插入语，表示「结果证明、到头来」；that 指代前文「我先是人」这件事。 举一反三：举一反三：It turns out she was right.

vocab.enExample: She left to run a quick errand.
vocab.note: 用法：run errands 办杂事、跑腿。

vocab.enExample: We postponed the trip until Monday.
vocab.zhExample: 我们把行程推迟到了周一。
vocab.note: 用法：post-（之后）+ pone（放）→ 往后放；postpone a trip 推迟行程。

vocab.enExample: We ate the leftovers for lunch.
vocab.note: 用法：the leftovers of the week 一周的残局；eat the leftovers 吃剩菜。
用法：指固定会做的小事，带点仪式感。
用法：re-（重新）+ write；rewrite Sundays 重过周日。

vocab.enExample: His thoughts drifted to the sea.
vocab.note: 用法：let the morning drift 让早晨慢淌；drift through life 浑浑噩噩。

vocab.enExample: The steam rose from the cup.
vocab.note: 用法：watch the steam 看热气升腾。
用法：the tasks do not complain 拟人化，指事不会催你。
用法：more productive 更高效；a productive meeting 高效的会。
用法：more human 更有温度；反义机械的。
